title: Research Knowledge Ontology Independent Review v1
goal: Independently review the frozen Research Knowledge Ontology v0.1 and 16-case blind replay benchmark for scientific validity, provenance/source-precedence correctness, anti-leak integrity, authority separation, generality, and non-tautological decision support before any projection implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Review exact ontology design blob 9af5bea619ec5a2f83575b4c8d73d08922f05bdb and replay benchmark blob 45bd39a722fc4ec24c8f29ce6c1d4eacda8c7998 without modifying them.
Determine whether epistemic, normative/scientific-authority, execution, and CandidateAction/DecisionEvaluation layers are sufficiently separated to prevent graph-created authority.
Determine whether source precedence preserves stale/history while producing a defensible current-state view from merged authoritative artifacts.

Verify contradictions, supersession, preregistered verdicts, posthoc non-verdict evidence, invalid execution, validation unavailable, blocked evidence, and rejected-mechanism reopening remain distinct states.
Verify the blind replay contract prevents projection/query code from reading case IDs, expected labels, required points, forbidden claims, or benchmark gold.
Assess whether the 16 structured query inputs test reusable graph/query semantics rather than encouraging case-specific hardcoding.
Verify all replay cases bind exact durable provenance and do not require sealed acceptance-benchmark access.

Assess whether pass criteria are strong enough: 16/16 exact replay, 16/16 provenance, zero authority escapes, zero stale overrides, zero verdict/posthoc conflation, zero invalid-vs-negative conflation, zero gold leakage, zero case-specific logic.
Return NO_BLOCKING_FINDING or exact blocking findings. No implementation authority exists until a NO_BLOCKING_FINDING is durably consumed by the owner task.
constraints: Do not implement the projection or query engine.
Do not mutate workspace-research-knowledge-ontology-v1 science/design/benchmark artifacts.
Do not mutate Local EXTRACT, research-engine, semantic-control integration, policy, production routing, or the sealed acceptance benchmark.
Do not treat zero-step CI failures as PASS or scientific evidence.
Do not rubber-stamp because the design follows prior ontology/semantic-control work; explicitly test for tautology, benchmark leakage, source-precedence errors, and authority laundering.
If a blocker is found, identify the exact result-affecting contract surface and avoid proposing unrelated architecture expansion.

evidence: Owner task is stopped at independent_preimplementation_review_ready.
Design and benchmark blobs are durable on main.
No projection implementation exists in this task.

outputs: BLOCKER 1 — INVALID_EXECUTION discrimination is not non-vacuously tested. The 16 replay cases contain VALID_NEGATIVE_SCIENCE, VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE, and BLOCKED_EVIDENCE outcomes, but no case whose expected outcome is INVALID_EXECUTION. Therefore an implementation that never produces INVALID_EXECUTION can still satisfy invalid_execution_scientific_negative_conflation_count=0.

BLOCKER 2 — contradiction preservation is not tested by the frozen replay and its zero-count gate is dropped from benchmark pass criteria. No replay case contains coexisting contradictory assertions, while the design requires contradiction_silent_collapse_count_required=0. A projection that silently collapses contradictions can therefore pass all 16 cases.

BLOCKER 3 — the frozen benchmark does not cover every query family the design marks required. bounded_query_contract.required_query_families includes WHY_CURRENT_EXPERIMENT, but the 16 replay cases contain zero WHY_CURRENT_EXPERIMENT cases. A missing or incorrect handler can pass the frozen benchmark.

BLOCKER 4 — the blind-replay boundary does not operationally prevent benchmark-specific memorization. All 16 query-engine-visible tuples (query_family plus structured query_input, including target_id and ask) are fixed and unique. A lookup keyed by those visible fields can reproduce the expected outputs without reading case IDs or gold at runtime. no_case_specific_logic=true and case_specific_logic_count=0 are declarations only; the frozen contract specifies no executable anti-hardcoding/metamorphic/identifier-remapping or equivalent detection step.

BLOCKER 5 — exact model-free scoring is underspecified. Cases freeze expected_answer_class plus natural-language required_points/forbidden_claims, but neither the design nor benchmark freezes a deterministic comparison/canonicalization rule for those natural-language fields. model_free_primary_scoring=true and exact_case_answer_pass=16/16 therefore do not define a reproducible pass/fail function before implementation.
